claims.summary: For every exponent lambda!=0 and M>=2, the bipartite neck space H_lambda = <(1+-T)^(-lambda)(1+eps b_i T)^(-lambda)> equals T^(-lambda) E (U_x + tau U_x) with y=1/T, x=eps T, U_x=<(1+b_i x)^(-lambda)>, E the even part of (1+y)^(-lambda) (a unit on the neck annulus) and tau=O/E=-tanh(lambda artanh y); so its neck Newton polygon is that of U_x + tau U_x. tau has the Gauss continued fraction -lambda y/(1+(lambda^2-1)y^2/(3+(lambda^2-4)y^2/(5+...))), whose partial numerators are nonzero for non-integer lambda, so its odd Pade table is normal along the staircase of two adjacent diagonals (Hankel determinants H0_n, H1_n of F nonzero, tau = -y F(y^2): staircase normality).
claims.assessment: Working proof after one fresh-context medium review; the identity, the continued fraction to order y^46 and the Hankel determinants through size 12 are also checked exactly at lambda=3/2.
claims.rationale: Identifies the source of the extra cancellation in the neck window valuations with Pade normality of an explicit classical function.

claims.summary: For every M>=2, every non-integer exponent lambda and generic b, the neck coefficient matrix of the bipartite space <(1+-T)^(-lambda)(1+eps b_i T)^(-lambda)> has val det C[:,W_k]=M(M-1)+k(k+1) on the windows W_k={-M+k..M-1+k}, k=0..M, with nonzero leading coefficient, and the windows are the unique minimizers between the breakpoints j/M.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; exact window valuations match for lambda in {3/2,5/2,1/2,7/3} at M=3,4, and fail for integer lambda (M>=3 for lambda=1) (all zero at lambda=1, low windows zero at lambda=2), as predicted from the continued fraction; exactly the binom(2k,k) Hall-minimal Toeplitz minors are nonzero, so the cancellation is an identity among Schur-weighted terms.
claims.rationale: General-exponent form of the neck window conjecture, whose proof should use only Pade normality of tanh(lambda artanh y).
claims.next_action: Prove the window valuations from the Hankel system of U_x + tau U_x: negative-side elements from Pade normality, positive-side from the tails of U_x.

relationships: The lambda=3/2 case is the earlier conjecture.
The conjecture is posed for the reduced space.
Neck edges come from the half-integral class.
